name: Can I fit an ADU without losing all of my yard space?

mainEntity.name: Can I fit an ADU without losing all of my yard space in a typical Los Angeles backyard?
mainEntity.text: Can I fit an ADU without losing all of my yard space in a typical Los Angeles backyard?

acceptedAnswer.text: Many lots can fit an ADU without sacrificing the entire backyard, but only if the design is intentional. The best layouts often place the unit along one side yard, behind existing landscaping, or near an old garage footprint instead of centering it in the middle of the yard. Compact floor plans, stacked wet areas, simple roof forms, and efficient circulation help reduce the footprint. A good designer will also consider what outdoor space matters most: dining area, play space, pool access, privacy, or garden area. The goal is not only to maximize buildable square footage but to preserve the parts of the yard the homeowner actually uses. On smaller lots, a larger ADU may be possible but may create a cramped outdoor environment. That is why a site-specific plan is more useful than a generic model. The right design should balance living area, yard usability, privacy, and construction cost.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, but the result depends on layout strategy, unit size, setbacks, circulation, and where the ADU is placed. A well-designed ADU can preserve usable yard space by using a compact footprint, a smart orientation, and efficient indoor planning instead of spreading the unit across the lot.
